description: This Java source file defines the class TbDDFFileParser, which parses XML-based Device Description Files (DDF) for LwM2m objects, validating and converting XML nodes into ObjectModel and ResourceModel instances.

classes.name: TbDDFFileParser
classes.description: A parser class for reading and validating XML-based Device Description Files (DDF) for LwM2m objects, converting XML nodes into ObjectModel and ResourceModel instances.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an InputStream containing a DDF XML file, validates it, and returns a list of ObjectModel instances.

methods.name: parseObject
methods.description: Converts an XML Node representing an Object into an ObjectModel instance, extracting attributes and child nodes.

methods.name: parseResource
methods.description: Converts an XML Node representing a Resource Item into a ResourceModel instance, extracting resource details.
